package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

func ensureLessonRuntimeCanBeCleared(ctx context.Context, tasks repository.TaskRepository, lessonID string) error {
	if tasks == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: cannot verify sandbox task runtimes", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	lessonTasks, err := tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, task := range lessonTasks {
		if task.RequiresSandbox && task.ComposeConfigID == nil && !domain.HasComposeConfig(task.ComposeConfig) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: lesson compose config is required by sandbox task %s", domain.ErrValidation, task.ID)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
